title: Shipped keybind profiles
description: The read-only keybind profiles the game ships. Each profile is a whole keymap, never a delta.

name.description: Display name, and the id a surface stores as the active selection. Unique across both lists.

fakeMeta.description: Key to treat as the Meta modifier, if the profile wants one.

keyset.description: Keyset exactly as /bind expects it, including any modifier prefix and comma-separated chain.

action.description: Bind command plus its space-separated arguments.

priority.description: Action prefixes, highest priority first. Two actions on one key are tried in the order they were bound, so bind files are emitted with these actions first; anything unlisted keeps the order it already had.

profiles.description: Selectable profiles, ordered; the first is what a surface falls back to when nothing valid is selected.
